name: Boiler motor control centres / variable speed drives and electrical supply for fans and pumps
description: Provide motor starting, protection and speed control for forced-draft/induced-draft fans, combustion-air blowers and boiler feedwater/service water pumps. VFDs replace throttling valves/inlet dampers with speed control, reducing energy use, wear and start-up current; BMS/CCS panels integrate VFDs with burner control.
